The '''Office Atrium''' was the name given to the upper levels of the [[Ternion Building]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:GtMA" /><ref name="TOR:RRA" /> [[New Venture Plaza]] was located at the western end of the building,<ref name="TOR:LOA" /> with the [[New Venture Terrace]] above it, and the [[Karsoom]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] established a [[mercenary training facility]] in the northern rooms of the atrium.<ref name="TOR:UOA" /> After their [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Eternal Empire]] built a [[Nar Shaddaa shield bunker|shield bunker]] for the [[Nar Shaddaa Star Fortress]] in the Ternion Building overlooking the plaza, with the only entrance located on the terrace.<ref name="TOR:NSTSB">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Nar Shaddaa: The Shield Bunker|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
